description: The TJX Companies, Inc. is the leading off-price apparel and home fashions retailer in the United States and worldwide, with over 5,200 stores and six branded e-commerce sites that offer a rapidly changing assortment of quality, fashionable, brand name and designer merchandise at prices generally 20 to 60 percent below full-price retailers' regular prices on comparable merchandise, every day, and its mission is to deliver great value to its customers every day. In its stores and online it offers consumers its value proposition of brand, fashion, price and quality, and its opportunistic buying strategies and flexible business model differentiate it from traditional retailers, offering a treasure hunt shopping experience and a rapid turn of inventories relative to traditional retailers, with a goal of creating a sense of excitement and urgency for its customers and encouraging frequent customer visits.
